title: Title Town Sports Walking Tour
blurb: Explore Boston's rich sports history on foot! Dynasty beginnings to banner nights—experience the legacies that make this town shimmer! Come discover why Boston gets its Title Town reputation with a walk through the Celtics, Bruins, and Patriots' storied histories. Learn the powerful beginnings of each team and how they rose to elite prominence, giving Boston unforgettable record-setting title runs. Follow the Freedom Trail to TD Garden and learn about how America's earliest values overlay with this Title Town's sports legacy and discover the inspirational and complex connections between the city's diverse populations and their accomplished sports teams. Journey from Government Center to TD Garden - along the Champion's Parade Route, through Boston's historic West End via the Freedom Trail, and on to the 'Hub on Causeway' at TD Garden - all while discovering iconic monuments, hidden sports spots, and rich sports history along the way.
